function.name: BoardGameGeek_recommend
function.description: Generate game recommendation from BoardGameGeek store based on number of players and category. Unlike AmazonGameStore_recommend, which generates a game recommendation from Amazon Game Store, this generates a game recommendation from BoardGameGeek store.

numPlayers.description: The number of players who will play the game.

category.description: The preferred category of board game. E.g. strategy, family, party etc.

difficulty.description: Preferred difficulty level. E.g. beginner, intermediate, advanced etc. This is an optional parameter. Default 'beginner'

function.name: AmazonGameStore_recommend
function.description: Generate game recommendation from Amazon Game Store based on number of players and category. Unlike BoardGameGeek_recommend, which generates a game recommendation from BoardGameGeek store, this generates a game recommendation from Amazon Game Store.

numOfPlayers.description: The number of players who will play the game.

category.description: The preferred category of board game. E.g. strategy, family, party etc.

priceRange.description: The price range you are willing to pay for the board game. E.g. $10-$20, $20-$30 etc. This is an optional parameter. Default ''
